name: @volt/web-runtime
description: Runs the VOLT server and cluster daemon unchanged inside browser workers. src/platform implements the Node APIs they use (loopback http, fs over OPFS, better-sqlite3 and DuckDB over their WebAssembly builds, child_process and worker_threads as workers); native addons are compiled to WebAssembly from their own sources; scripts/build.mjs bundles each backend's built dist against it.
